name: @ever-works/jira-connector-plugin
description: JIRA connector plugin for Ever Works platform (outbound issue comments via jira.js and event-source pull of issues/comments into the event-ingest pipeline, with opt-in historical backfill)

plugin.name: JIRA Connector
plugin.description: JIRA connector. Outbound posts comments on JIRA issues via the jira.js Cloud REST client. Event-source pull ingests issues (created/updated) and comments since the last watermark into the platform event-ingest pipeline, with opt-in historical backfill (backfillDays, max 90).

projectKeys.title: Project keys to ingest events from (comma-separated; all projects when empty)

backfillDays.title: Historical backfill window in days on first pull (0 = off, max 90)

defaultIssueKey.title: Default issue key for outbound comments (e.g. ENG-42)

webhookSecret.title: Webhook secret
webhookSecret.description: Secret set on the Jira Cloud webhook that points at the platform ingest receiver (POST /api/ingest/jira/events). Jira signs every delivery with it (X-Hub-Signature, HMAC SHA-256); deliveries with a missing or mismatched signature are rejected, so a webhook created without a secret never files anything. Leave blank to keep the inbound receiver disabled for your account.
